title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Credix

is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer . You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.

Responsibilities

  • Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment.
  • Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria.
  • Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours.
  • Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed.
  • Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
  • Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
  • Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs.
  • Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
  • Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
  • Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
  • Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
  • Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

title: ANALISTA DE PRODUTOS PLENO
description:

title: IT Data Engineer Senior
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados do mundo nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com um dos portfólios mais amplos de seguros do mercado, comercializamos nossos produtos através do canal de vendas do banco Santander Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.

Hoje estamos procurando um IT Data Engineer Senior. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, aqui é o seu lugar!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis, confiáveis e observáveis (batch e streaming).
  • Garantir qualidade, governança, segurança e conformidade dos dados (LGPD).
  • Atuar como referência técnica para engenheiros de dados, promovendo boas práticas, padrões e mentoria.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, analytics, ciência de dados e produto.
  • Avaliar e definir tecnologias, ferramentas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Otimizar custos, performance e confiabilidade em ambientes cloud.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de dados estratégicas.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior ou Especialista.
  • Amplo conhecimento e experiência na plataforma Databricks
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e programação (Python e/ou Scala).
  • Experiência com Big Data (Spark necessário, Kafka, Flink ou similares desejáveis).
  • Vivência com cloud Azure.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquiteturas modernas (Lakehouse).
  • Experiência com orquestração (Datafactory, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Práticas de engenharia de software (CI/CD, versionamento, testes).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados analítica.
  • Experiência com governança, qualidade de dados e segurança.

Habilidades e competências:

  • Habilidade de liderança técnica e colaboração.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Visão estratégica e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Curiosidade, autonomia e foco em melhoria contínua.

Na OmniSmart , não entregamos apenas um software; entregamos transformação digital. Somos uma startup em escala e buscamos pessoas que queiram aprender rápido, testar hipóteses e crescer junto com o nosso produto. Aqui, inovação, aprendizagem e desafios são nossas essencias.

Como Analista de Implantação, você será o "rosto" da nossa solução durante a fase mais crítica da jornada do cliente: o Onboarding . Sua missão é garantir que a configuração seja indolor e que o cliente atinja o "Primeiro Valor" (Aha! Moment) no menor tempo possível.

  • Feedback Loop: Ser os "olhos e ouvidos" do time de Produto, reportando bugs e sugerindo melhorias com base na experiência real do usuário.

Overview

The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. This role oversees incident, problem, change, and enhancement management, ensuring compliance with SLAs, high-quality service delivery, and alignment with business objectives. The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Project Delivery

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.g., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).

Governance, Reporting & Financials

Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly service performance reports.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Recommend SAP process improvements and automation opportunities.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.g., ECC to S/4HANA).

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.

Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: Estágio em Recursos Humanos

Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas.

  • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, nosso regime de trabalho é hibrido e flexível ! Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

Como estagiário(a) do nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

As suas principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a equipe em projetos e programas relacionados à gestão de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a equipe em atividades de recrutamento e seleção, como triagem de currículos, agendamento de entrevistas e feedback aos candidatos;
  • Apoio nas ações de diversidade, organização de eventos, ações de clima e brindes;

  • Cursando graduação a partir do 5º período;
  • Disponibilidade de estagiar 6h por dia;
  • Inglês avançado.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Frontend Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

O Analista de frontend irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, com um potencial enorme de crescimento.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a arquitetura front-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar, capacitar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;
  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação para front-end Angular – nível avançado;
  • Conceitos de DevOps (Observabilidade, SRE, outros) – nível básico;
  • Esteira (CI/CD) - intermediário;
  • Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;
  • Sistemas distribuídos (contêineres, kubernetes, swarm, outros) – nível básico;
  • Testes unitários, técnicas de manutenibilidade e resolução de vulnerabilidades - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados (SQL, NoSQL) – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software –nível intermediário;

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Executivo de Vendas Enterprise
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA VAGA

Nós estamos procurando por um executivo de vendas Sr para os nossos contratos com empresas globais e multinacionais. O Gerente de Negócios será responsável pelo funil completo de vendas, atuando como hunter de clientes potenciais enterprise.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver plano de negócios anual, determinando metas de vendas e ações para o atingimento da cota estabelecida; alcançar e superar cota através da carteira designada;
  • Produzir um Relatório de Empresas a Prospectar em 120 Dias, o qual identifique empresas em potencial e as ações para fechamento de contrato;
  • Assegurar gerenciamento, planejamento e feedbacks constantes a respeito da carteira de clientes;
  • Identificar insatisfação dos clientes em relação aos produtos e serviços existentes e executar plano de ações a fim de resolver problemas e reter clientes;
  • Gerar vendas para novos e atuais clientes enquanto garante alta satisfação.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência sênior como sales hunter na indústria de TI
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente;
  • Experiência com cold calls;
  • Experiência com vendas complexas e ciclos de venda de pelo menos 3 meses para clientes Enterprise
  • Formação superior completa

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é híbrido, sendo 3 dias de trabalho no escritório e 2 dias home-office.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

  • Realizar prospecção de clientes ;

  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.

  • Ensino Médio Completo;

  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.

Local de trabalho: Rua São Bento, 402, Centro Histórico, São Paulo, Brasil

Jornada: 100% presencial

Horário de trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h

Salário Fixo

Remuneração Variável

E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region
*Note: Total Rewards at Kenvue include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits. Your Talent Access Partner will be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the recruitment & hiring process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.

Role reports to:
GER FINANCAS
Location:
Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos
Work Location:
Hybrid
What you will do
The Sr Finance Analyst will support on Business Planning & Actual Results and the periodic Forecast Updates processes with business partners, ensuring the reliability of the information and its timely submission. He/she will be partnered with key financial and seniors' business stakeholders to analyze variation in budget vs actual drivers, operational metrics and frame results. This role will support Senior Leadership Team, Make/QA/Plan/RMC to achieve visibility on numbers.
The analyst will collaborate to ensure the reliability of the financial information, insightful commentary of financial drivers, communication of risks and opportunities and the application of compliance. This role will identify and implement opportunities to enhance financial analytics, capabilities within their finance team, work in simplification, standardization, agility, provide clear information to support decision making and influence the business. Additionally, implement process improvements by utilizing AI tools to optimize time and accelerate the delivery of results.
Key responsibilities
  • Perform analytics and reporting: review and communicate performance drivers, metrics, risks and opportunities and associated action plans
  • Planning and Forecasting: work with LATAM business partners to challenge assumptions, build models, review financial outputs with management and influence decision making. Provides inputs in financial planning process.
  • Conduct BVA meetings, address necessary actions to fulfill financial commitments.
  • Perform closing activities to ensure continuous monitoring of the business' monthly budget to ensure cost-effective management and accuracy.
  • Risk management: run different financial scenarios for budget, based on volume and macroeconomics figures to provide recommendations to financially manage the business, and opportunely identify and communicate risks and opportunities.
  • Strategy and Decision Support: provide financial support to business cases for investment decisions and cost savings opportunities and actively contribute to site strategy. Supports decision making with comprehensive research and analysis.
  • Support continuous improvements for financial processes/analytics and other ad hoc analyses/projects
  • Audit and Compliance: oversite of internal controls for both US/SOX and local statutory requirements, support internal/external audits.
Qualifications:
  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in finance, Administration, Economics or Engineering .
  • Advanced Excel and experience with Power BI
  • Experience with SAP system
  • Professional with strong communication skills, able to interact with senior management
  • Strong collaboration and demonstrated business partnering with the ability to influence
  • Strong analytical capabilities
  • Proactiveness and intellectual curiosity
  • General knowledge of supply chain processes
  • Advanced level of English is required for this position
  • Intermediate or higher levels of Spanish can be considered a differential.
If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.
